mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USERS WHERE ROLE_CODE != 7) AS TOTAL_USERS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USERS WHERE ROLE_CODE = 7) AS WITHDRAWN_USERS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MATCHES) AS TOTAL_MATCHES, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MATCHES WHERE STATUS IN ('SCHEDULED', 'TIMED')) AS SCHEDULED_MATCHES, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MATCHES m WHERE m.STATUS = 'FINISHED' AND ( NVL(m.HOME_SCORE, 0) != ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MATCH_EVENTS me WHERE me.MATCH_ID = m.MATCH_ID AND me.TEAM_ID = m.HOME_TEAM_ID AND me.EVENT_TYPE IN (1, 2, 3) ) OR NVL(m.AWAY_SCORE, 0) != ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MATCH_EVENTS me WHERE me.MATCH_ID = m.MATCH_ID AND me.TEAM_ID = m.AWAY_TEAM_ID AND me.EVENT_TYPE IN (1, 2, 3) ) ) ) AS MISMATCH_MATCHES, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PLAYER_STATS WHERE IS_INJURED = 'Y') AS INJURED_PLAYERS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POSTS WHERE IS_BLIND = 'Y' AND IS_DELETED = 'N') AS BLIND_POSTS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMENTS WHERE IS_BLIND = 'Y' AND IS_DELETED = 'N') AS BLIND_COMMENTS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POSTS WHERE IS_DELETED = 'Y') AS DELETED_POSTS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMENTS WHERE IS_DELETED = 'Y') AS DELETED_COMMENTS FROM DUAL

SELECT m.MATCH_ID, m.MATCH_DATE, m.HOME_TEAM_ID, m.AWAY_TEAM_ID, m.HOME_SCORE, m.AWAY_SCORE, m.STATUS, m.NOTICE, m.ENDED_AT, h.TEAM_NAME AS HOME_TEAM_NAME, h.TEAM_NAME_KOR AS HOME_TEAM_NAME_KOR, h.EMBLEM_URL AS HOME_EMBLEM_URL, a.TEAM_NAME AS AWAY_TEAM_NAME, a.TEAM_NAME_KOR AS AWAY_TEAM_NAME_KOR, a.EMBLEM_URL AS AWAY_EMBLEM_URL, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MATCH_EVENTS me WHERE me.MATCH_ID = m.MATCH_ID AND me.TEAM_ID = m.HOME_TEAM_ID AND me.EVENT_TYPE IN (1, 2, 3) ) AS HOME_GOAL_EVENTS, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MATCH_EVENTS me WHERE me.MATCH_ID = m.MATCH_ID AND me.TEAM_ID = m.AWAY_TEAM_ID AND me.EVENT_TYPE IN (1, 2, 3) ) AS AWAY_GOAL_EVENTS, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MATCH_EVENTS me WHERE me.MATCH_ID = m.MATCH_ID ) AS TOTAL_EVENTS FROM MATCHES m LEFT JOIN TEAMS h ON h.TEAM_ID = m.HOME_TEAM_ID LEFT JOIN TEAMS a ON a.TEAM_ID = m.AWAY_TEAM_ID
AND m.STATUS = #{status}
AND m.STATUS = 'FINISHED' AND ( NVL(m.HOME_SCORE, 0) != ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MATCH_EVENTS me WHERE me.MATCH_ID = m.MATCH_ID AND me.TEAM_ID = m.HOME_TEAM_ID AND me.EVENT_TYPE IN (1, 2, 3) ) OR NVL(m.AWAY_SCORE, 0) != ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MATCH_EVENTS me WHERE me.MATCH_ID = m.MATCH_ID AND me.TEAM_ID = m.AWAY_TEAM_ID AND me.EVENT_TYPE IN (1, 2, 3) ) )
AND TRUNC(CAST(m.MATCH_DATE AS DATE)) = TO_DATE(#{date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
ORDER BY m.MATCH_DATE ASC
ORDER BY m.MATCH_DATE DESC
ORDER BY m.MATCH_DATE ASC
ORDER BY m.MATCH_DATE DESC
ORDER BY m.MATCH_DATE DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE MATCHES SET HOME_SCORE = #{homeScore, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, AWAY_SCORE = #{awayScore, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, STATUS = #{status}, ENDED_AT = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'FINISHED' AND ENDED_AT IS NULL THEN SYSTIMESTAMP ELSE ENDED_AT END WHERE MATCH_ID = #{matchId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.PLAYER_ID, p.NAME AS PLAYER_NAME, p.NAME_KOR AS PLAYER_NAME_KOR, p.MAIN_POSITION, p.DETAIL_POSITION, p.NATIONALITY, p.NATIONALITY_KOR, p.TEAM_ID, t.TEAM_NAME, t.TEAM_NAME_KOR, t.EMBLEM_URL, NVL(ps.GOALS, 0) AS GOALS, NVL(ps.ASSISTS, 0) AS ASSISTS, NVL(ps.MOM_COUNT, 0) AS MOM_COUNT, NVL(ps.YELLOW_CARDS, 0) AS YELLOW_CARDS, NVL(ps.RED_CARDS, 0) AS RED_CARDS, NVL(ps.IS_INJURED, 'N') AS IS_INJURED, ps.INJURY_NOTE, NVL(ps.IS_SUSPENDED, 'N') AS IS_SUSPENDED FROM PLAYERS p LEFT JOIN PLAYER_STATS ps ON ps.PLAYER_ID = p.PLAYER_ID LEFT JOIN TEAMS t ON t.TEAM_ID = p.TEAM_ID WHERE p.TEAM_ID = #{teamId} ORDER BY CASE p.MAIN_POSITION WHEN 'GK' THEN 1 WHEN 'DF' THEN 2 WHEN 'MF' THEN 3 WHEN 'FW' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END ASC, p.NAME ASC
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO PLAYER_STATS ps USING (SELECT #{playerId} AS PLAYER_ID FROM DUAL) s ON (ps.PLAYER_ID = s.PLAYER_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ps.IS_INJURED = #{isInjured}, ps.INJURY_NOTE = #{injuryNote, jdbcType=CLOB}, ps.IS_SUSPENDED = NVL(#{isSuspended, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N') WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( PLAYER_ID, GOALS, ASSISTS, MOM_COUNT, YELLOW_CARDS, RED_CARDS, IS_INJURED, IS_SUSPENDED, INJURY_NOTE ) VALUES ( #{playerId}, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, #{isInjured}, NVL(#{isSuspended, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N'), #{injuryNote, jdbcType=CLOB} )
mapper.select: SELECT p.PLAYER_ID, p.NAME AS PLAYER_NAME, p.NAME_KOR AS PLAYER_NAME_KOR, p.MAIN_POSITION, p.DETAIL_POSITION, t.TEAM_ID, t.TEAM_NAME, t.TEAM_NAME_KOR, ps.IS_INJURED, ps.INJURY_NOTE, ps.IS_SUSPENDED FROM PLAYER_STATS ps JOIN PLAYERS p ON p.PLAYER_ID = ps.PLAYER_ID JOIN TEAMS t ON t.TEAM_ID = p.TEAM_ID WHERE ps.IS_INJURED = 'Y' OR ps.IS_SUSPENDED = 'Y' ORDER BY t.TEAM_NAME ASC, p.NAME ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE POSTS SET IS_DELETED = 'Y', UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE POST_ID = #{postId} AND IS_DELETED = 'N'

SELECT u.USER_ID, u.LOGIN_ID, u.NICKNAME, u.EMAIL, u.FAVORITE_TEAM_ID, u.ROLE_CODE, u.POINT, u.CREATED_AT, u.UPDATED_AT, r.ROLE_NAME FROM USERS u LEFT JOIN USER_ROLES r ON r.ROLE_CODE = u.ROLE_CODE
AND (u.LOGIN_ID LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR u.NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR u.EMAIL LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
AND u.ROLE_CODE = #{roleCode}
AND u.ROLE_CODE != 7
ORDER BY u.USER_ID DESC

SELECT u.USER_ID, u.LOGIN_ID, u.NICKNAME, u.EMAIL, u.FAVORITE_TEAM_ID, u.ROLE_CODE, u.POINT, u.CREATED_AT, u.UPDATED_AT, r.ROLE_NAME FROM USERS u LEFT JOIN USER_ROLES r ON r.ROLE_CODE = u.ROLE_CODE WHERE u.USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POINT_HISTORY ( USER_ID, PREDICTION_ID, AMOUNT, BALANCE_AFTER, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{predictionId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{description}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT ph.POINT_HISTORY_ID, ph.USER_ID, ph.PREDICTION_ID, ph.AMOUNT, ph.BALANCE_AFTER, ph.DESCRIPTION, ph.CREATED_AT FROM POINT_HISTORY ph ORDER BY ph.POINT_HISTORY_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY
